facts.business: Hemang Resources Limited is a listed company based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with promoter holdings in equity and preference shares, and operations involving trade receivables and fixed assets such as computers, furniture, and vehicles.
facts.related_party_note: Mr. Syed Khaja Alimuddeen transferred Power of Attorney to Mr. Deepak Tiwary, Ex-Whole Time Director and Ex-Chief Executive Officer of Hemang Resources Ltd. During the year 2025-26 under review, company has recovered the dues by selling the said property.
